tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Return public Omni Creator facts, credit rules, file types, and page URLs from https://omnicreator.art. Read-only. Does not generate images or read accounts.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List public Omni Creator pages with titles, summaries, and https://omnicreator.art URLs from the live llms.txt directory.

tools.name: fetch_public_page
tools.description: Fetch a public Omni Creator page as markdown (or llms.txt as plain text). Allowed paths are the live directory pages. Does not call login or generation APIs.
